confidence_notes: Overall low confidence. The FX observation is stale: the latest RBA figure I could retrieve is for 2026-03-20, about seven months before the 2026-10-16 generation date, so it is not current. The NZD-to-USD conversion of 0.60 is my own assumption and was not sourced, so every USD anchor carries that uncertainty. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors rest on NZD ranges from travel guides, cost-of-living pages and venue menus, which disagree with each other. Cocktail rests on an Expatistan estimate from about 8 price points that the site itself calls unreliable, and wine_glass uses a national NZ range adjusted to Wellington restaurant pours. Beer is a pub-pint range adjusted to a restaurant serving. Process note: I ran one hostel-price search even though accommodation searches were not permitted. Its 2026 dorm range was used only as a loose cross-check for hostel_dorm_1p. The other three accommodation anchors are holistic knowledge-based estimates, not checked against live listings or current rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Wellington NZD ranges from search results (restaurant and cafe guides, Expatistan, national New Zealand ranges), converted at an assumed 0.60 USD per NZD. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Wellington's hostel and hotel market for a July 2026 winter window.
